title: Which AI model is the best stock trader? A finance professor says he's got the answer.
excerpt: Dr. Alejandro Lopez-Lira has been conducting his AI trading experiment since the beginning of the AI boom in 2023. He says one model stands out.
content_html:
By Samuel O'Brient

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Dr. Alejandro Lopez Lira has been trying to prompt AI chatbots to beat the market since 2023.

Lopez Lira, an associate professor of finance at the University of Florida, began his project early in the AI boom to see which model could trade stocks to deliver market-beating returns. After almost three years of testing the most popular models, he said he's got his answer.

"DeepSeek is by far the best trader," he told Business Insider.

DeepSeek's portfolio is up 73% since it launched in 2023 and 35% year-to-date. ChatGPT has slightly outpaced DeepSeek since launch, up 78%, but is only up 16% year-to-date. The Grok portfolio has returned 54% since inception and 19% year-to-date.

He said DeepSeek is also beating Claude, though he noted that Anthropic's chat bot hasn't been managing a portfolio for as long as the others.

Can DeepSeek beat the market? Our public experiment during the past year says yes: up 76% against 27% for the S&P 500.

$13.5M in client capital, 2,285 subscribers, every position live and public.

See it all and trade alongside here: https://t.co/e88z6qTdC8 pic.twitter.com/HVUGeVBPBX

— AI Finance Labs (@aifinancelabs) May 28, 2026

All of his AI-managed portfolios can be publicly viewed on Autopilot, an app that allows retail traders to copy moves made by successful investors, from Warren Buffett to Nancy Pelosi investors. Copy trading has become popular in recent years, and, according to Autopilot co-founder Chris Josephs, there has been increasing interest among users in copying trades made by AI-run stock portfolios.

"What's fascinating is we see people apply and want to launch more and more funds, launch more and more portfolios, and more people are using AI to essentially prompt out their ideas," he told Business Insider.

Lopez Lira said that while each AI model functions similarly in terms of information processing, he estimated that they only make the same calls about 50% of the time.

"There's some setup involved in the sense that you have to add the latest information to the model — firm news, various fundamentals, things like that — but the final decision is the model's completely."

In a GPT portfolio white paper shared on his Autopilot page, Lopez Lira provided examples of some of the prompts he's used in setting up the portfolio.

The platform also shows lists of recent trades each AI portfolio has made. Most recently, it shows 19 trades made by DeepSeek on July 14, including increasing its position in Nvidia and reducing its Vista Energy holdings.

While Micron Technology is the top holding for both DeepSeek and Grok's portfolios, the second-highest performing portfolio, ChatGPT, favors Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, a lesser known aerospace recently named as a top pick by Stifel.

While the Claude portfolio also holds Kratos stock, its top holding is the iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF, a stark contrast to the other bot's preferences for Big Tech and energy stocks. It also maintains a fairly large position in Vista Energy, a contrarian position relative to DeepSeek's move to reduce its position.

作者：Samuel O'Brient 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

自 2023 年以来，Alejandro Lopez Lira 博士一直致力于推动人工智能聊天机器人打败市场。

佛罗里达大学金融学副教授洛佩兹·利拉 (Lopez Lira) 在人工智能繁荣初期就开始了他的项目，看看哪种模型可以交易股票以提供跑赢市场的回报。 在对最受欢迎的型号进行了近三年的测试后，他说他已经找到了答案。

“DeepSeek 是迄今为止最好的交易员，”他告诉《商业内幕》。

DeepSeek 的投资组合自 2023 年推出以来增长了 73%，今年迄今增长了 35%。 自推出以来，ChatGPT 的增长速度略高于 DeepSeek，增长了 78%，但今年迄今仅增长了 16%。 Grok 投资组合自成立以来的回报率为 54%，今年迄今回报率为 19%。

他表示 DeepSeek 也击败了 Claude，不过他指出 Anthropic 的聊天机器人管理投资组合的时间没有其他机器人那么长。

DeepSeek 能否战胜市场？ 我们去年的公开实验结果表明是的：与标准普尔 500 指数的 27% 相比，增长了 76%。客户资本为 1,350 万美元，订阅者为 2,285 名，每个头寸都是实时公开的。 在这里查看全部内容并进行交易：https://t.co/e88z6qTdC8 pic.twitter.com/HVUGeVBPBX — AI 金融实验室 (@aifinancelabs) 2026 年 5 月 28 日

他所有由人工智能管理的投资组合都可以在 Autopilot 上公开查看，该应用程序允许零售交易者复制从沃伦·巴菲特到南希·佩洛西投资者等成功投资者的举动。 近年来，跟单交易变得越来越流行，据 Autopilot 联合创始人 Chris Josephs 称，用户对跟单由人工智能运行的股票投资组合进行的交易越来越感兴趣。

“令人着迷的是，我们看到人们申请并希望推出越来越多的基金，推出越来越多的投资组合，越来越多的人正在使用人工智能来本质上激发他们的想法，”他告诉《商业内幕》。

Lopez Lira 表示，虽然每个人工智能模型在信息处理方面的功能相似，但他估计它们只有大约 50% 的时间做出相同的调用。

“有一些设置涉及到你必须将最新信息添加到模型中——公司新闻、各种基本面等等——但最终的决定完全取决于模型。”

在他的 Autopilot 页面上分享的 GPT 投资组合白皮书中，Lopez Lira 提供了他在设置投资组合时使用的一些提示的示例。

该平台还显示每个人工智能投资组合最近进行的交易列表。 最近，它显示了 DeepSeek 在 7 月 14 日进行的 19 笔交易，包括增持 Nvidia 股份和减持 Vista Energy 股份。

虽然美光科技 (Micron Technology) 是 DeepSeek 和 Grok 投资组合的最大持股，但表现第二高的投资组合 ChatGPT 青睐 Kratos Defense & Security Solutions，这是一家鲜为人知的航空航天公司，最近被 Stifel 评为首选。

虽然 Claude 投资组合也持有 Kratos 股票，但其持有量最大的是 iShares 0-3 个月国债 ETF，这与另一个机器人对大型科技股和能源股的偏好形成鲜明对比。 它还在 Vista Energy 中保持了相当大的仓位，相对于 DeepSeek 减持仓位的举动来说，这是一个逆向仓位。
